chain.label: Unauthorized Part 135 charter operation under inadequate oversight
chain.trigger: PJM's conduct of charter flights...without proper FAA certification...Darby Aviation's failure to maintain operational control...the failure of the Birmingham FSDO to provide adequate surveillance and oversight...and the FAA's tacit approval of arrangements such as that between Darby and PJM

chain.label: Flight crew inadequately trained/qualified for the flight
chain.trigger: the captain had not yet received the additional Darby-specific Part135 indoctrination...the first officer had received only 22 of the 31 hours of ground training required...his FAA medical certificate had expired for the purposes of commercial operations

caused_by.evidence: resulted in an environment conducive to the development of systemic patterns of flight crew performance deficiencies like those observed in this accident

chain.label: Cabin aide lacked adequate safety training
chain.trigger: the cabin aide was not required to receive any safety-related training because she was not a required crewmember (flight attendant) for the accident flight

chain.label: Captain's poor CRM leadership and rushed preflight/taxi procedures
chain.trigger: the captain demonstrated poor leadership and failed to use all of the available resources when he failed to involve the first officer in fuel load planning and other preflight decision-making...rushed the checklist procedures

caused_by.evidence: resulted in an environment conducive to the development of systemic patterns of flight crew performance deficiencies like those observed in this accident

chain.label: Pilots failed to calculate the airplane's weight and balance/CG
chain.trigger: although they obtained an estimate of the airplane's weight...they did not calculate the airplane's CG in any way for the accident flight

caused_by.evidence: Most importantly, he did not ensure that the airplane's balance was calculated to verify that the flight would be operating within the approved weight-and-balance limits

chain.label: Airplane loaded with CG forward of the forward takeoff limit
chain.trigger: the calculated CG was about 12.47 percent MAC, whereas the forward CG limit was 16 percent MAC

caused_by.evidence: the airplane, as loaded for the accident flight, had a forward CG that was significantly forward of the airplane's forward limit, which severely degraded the airplane's ability to rotate

chain.label: Pilots attempted takeoff with out-of-limits forward CG
chain.trigger: their attempt to take off with the center of gravity well forward of the forward takeoff limit, which prevented the airplane from rotating at the intended rotation speed

caused_by.evidence: the airplane continued to accelerate beyond VR to about 160 knots calibrated airspeed without lifting off

chain.label: Captain did not apply maximum braking/reverse thrust immediately during the RTO
chain.trigger: the accident captain did not immediately employ all available deceleration devices, such as immediate deployment of maximum thrust reverse, to maximum effect after he decided to reject the takeoff

caused_by.evidence: about 5 seconds after the airplane accelerated through the rotation speed, the captain commanded a rejected takeoff (RTO)

chain.label: Cabin aide did not perform a seatbelt compliance check
chain.trigger: the cabin aide did not perform a seatbelt compliance check before the accident flight, which resulted in two passengers being unrestrained during the accident sequence

caused_by.evidence: the cabin aide's training did not adequately prepare her to perform the duties with which she was tasked

chain.label: Airplane ran off the departure end of runway 6
chain.trigger: ran off the departure end of runway 6 at Teterboro Airport (TEB)...at a ground speed of about 110 knots

caused_by.evidence: resulted in the accident airplane departing the runway at a higher speed than in the simulations
the airplane continued to accelerate on the runway until the captain rejected the takeoff, and the airplane never rotated

chain.label: Airplane struck a vehicle and a building beyond the airport
chain.trigger: through an airport perimeter fence; across a six-lane highway (where it struck a vehicle); and into a parking lot before impacting a building

caused_by.evidence: through an airport perimeter fence; across a six-lane highway...and into a parking lot before impacting a building

chain.label: Serious and minor injuries to occupants and others
chain.trigger: The two pilots were seriously injured, as were two occupants in the vehicle. The cabin aide, eight passengers, and one person in the building received minor injuries.

caused_by.evidence: The two pilots were seriously injured, as were two occupants in the vehicle.
the two unrestrained passengers were thrown to the cabin aisle floor during the RTO
